laws.rule: Non-residents 21 and over may possess up to 15 g of cannabis flower, 2.5 g of concentrate and 250 mg THC in infused products (residents have higher limits); public consumption is prohibited. Cannabis remains illegal under US federal law, including on federal land such as national parks.
Non-residents do not need a FOID card but must be eligible to possess firearms at home; a firearm being transported must be broken down, not immediately accessible, or unloaded and cased.
